# housesitter

> Keeps an always-on Mac that hosts AI agents alive and drivable, hands-off, through a cheap IP-KVM (GL.iNet Comet / any PiKVM-API KVM). A sitter on the KVM unlocks FileVault after a panic (typing a sealed copy of the password only at the prompt), power-cycles a hang through a smart plug, and messages you once when stuck. Agents get screenshot/click/type/key on the Mac from before login, in Anthropic computer-use shape, over Tailscale, LAN or a GitHub gist outbox.

## Start
- [README](README.md): what it does, quickstart, status
- `housesitter demo`: a rehearsed night, no hardware
- `housesitter adopt <mac> --fake`: arrival day, rehearsed

## For agents driving a Mac
- `housesitter ls <mac>` then `housesitter do <mac> <action> '<json>'` (Ouro Reins shape; refusals action-unavailable / input-invalid / action-failed; exit 0 ok, 2 refused, 1 failed)
- `housesitter computer <mac> '{"action":"left_click","coordinate":[x,y]}'` (Anthropic computer-use input as-is)
- Library: `import { open } from '@ouro.bot/housesitter'` → `screenshot/click/type/key/scroll/computer`
- Coordinates are in the last screenshot's pixels.
- Never type a password; `type` refuses anything that looks like one. Ask the sitter: `housesitter unlock <mac>`.
- Mac locked and you need its UI? `housesitter want-desktop <mac> [--minutes 10]` (or the Reins action `want_desktop`): the sitter unlocks it through its own gates, only if its config says `"unlock_lock_screen": "on_request"` or `true`; otherwise action-unavailable.
- Smart plug: `housesitter plug <mac> find|adopt [ip]|status|prove --attended`.
- Health probe: config `health` is `{host, port}` (TCP) or `{kind: "json_age", url, field, max_age_min}` (a heartbeat JSON; fresh = up, unreachable = unknown).
- Mutual watch: `housesitter watch-kvm <mac> --install` on the Mac: a LaunchAgent that asks the sitter for its status every minute over SSH (`do watch_check`), or, when SSH can't reach the KVM and an outbox is configured, from the outbox gist (`ok via outbox` in its log), and sends one message after 5 min of silence and one when it's back, sharing the sitter's daily email cap. `doctor` shows "watched by the Mac itself".
- Messages: ntfy or a webhook; `adopt --notify ntfy --email <address>` also emails one address through an ntfy.sh account (token: `housesitter secret <mac> ntfy-token`; 5 emails a day on a free account). `housesitter alert-test <mac>` sends one real stuck message marked TEST.

## Housesitter, the agent on the KVM
- [plugins/housesitter](plugins/housesitter/README.md): an Ouro plugin. MCP tools sitter_status, sitter_look, sitter_screenshot, sitter_unlock, sitter_want_desktop, sitter_power_cycle, sitter_power_on, sitter_click, sitter_type, sitter_key, sitter_scroll (each runs `sitter.py do <op>` and returns its reply as is), peer_send, peer_inbox, kvm_health; watch.py wakes the agent with `ouro msg --to <agent>`; skills/housesitter/SKILL.md.
- Peer link with the agent on the Mac: `housesitter peer send <text> [--re <id>] [--now]`, `housesitter peer inbox [--peek]`, `housesitter peer flush [--now]`. Free text, one gist file per message; sends are queued and flushed in one PATCH at most every 6 minutes (`--now`/`now` at once), at most 10 gist writes an hour each way (HOUSESITTER_PEER_FLUSH_SEC, HOUSESITTER_PEER_MAX_PER_HOUR).

## Code
- src/watchdog.mjs and device/sitter.py: the same rules, both tested against spec/watchdog-cases.json
- src/hands.mjs: the pixel driver and transports
- src/adopt.mjs: arrival day
- device/sitter.py: the always-on watcher on the KVM (Python 3 standard library only)
- src/peer.mjs and plugins/housesitter/peer.py: the two ends of the peer link
